environment.name: CompactIndustrialWarehouse
environment.collision_scope: Original triangles are a visual preview. Physics uses a solid axis-aligned bounding-box proxy, centered at the chosen position and scale, plus the standard Panda workbench. A concave room must not be treated as an accurate solid-box reconstruction.

result.conclusion: Measured physical pickup and placement found.

steps: Inspect structured observation and valid action schema.
Generate candidate interventions through backend tools.
Fork the same persisted state for each candidate.

search.sampling: seeded lift-height templates and distinct speed/close-dwell/release-dwell commands
search.screening_scope: actual template IK/kinematic contacts plus per-candidate timing/horizon checks; no dynamic success claim
search.ranking_objective: successful execution, measured duration, placement error, candidate index

performance.compute: CPU; one worker; process CPU time includes concurrent API activity; no billed model calls under deterministic policy
